values.note: Run by the Forest Service (Mio Ranger District; unstaffed). Reserve on recreation.gov; sites 1 and 7 are first-come only, and the rate table runs a first-come, first-served season Oct. 1 - Nov. 30. Occupy a reserved site within 24 hours of its start or it may be forfeited.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214365 (org FS, is_commercially_managed false; 'This location is unstaffed'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minConsecutiveStay 1; notice 'You must occupy your site within 24 hours of the start of your reservation') + catalog (2 standard sites reservable: false) + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-10-01..11-30), read 2026-10-25

note: Huron NF campground on the National Scenic stretch of the Au Sable River, a short walk from the river (a small spring at the river's edge by the gabions, rock-filled erosion baskets); sites shaded by hardwoods, red and jack pine, each with picnic table, fire ring and lantern post. Off Brodie Road north of Au Sable River Road. The Shore-to-Shore Trail passes through, but horse camping is not permitted. OHV trail access at the campground road. --Claude
